text: Practice single-tasking. When you eat, feel the taste of the food; when you listen to a person, be entirely in their words and thoughts (that is, without thinking through your response at that time). Wisdom is born not in dispersion, but in bringing your attention to a single point, whether it is a work task, a creative act, or the gaze of a loved one. Give up the illusion of the effectiveness of multitasking in order to discover greater depth in the present moment.
